roles.name: --border
roles.purpose: frames and lines: a frame on a resting container and the splits between its sections, a line on controls and between rows

roles.name: --line-height-body
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-caption
roles.purpose: the smallest type roles: metadata, badges, field errors, nav items, the status strip
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --muted-foreground
roles.purpose: secondary text — hints, metadata. L .50 is the lightest that clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface muted text sits on, muted and accent included

roles.name: --primary
roles.purpose: the brand fill: the one primary action per view, the active nav item

roles.name: --primary-ink
roles.purpose: the brand colour as text or a glyph on a surface — a link, a record's mark — readable in both themes where the brand fill itself is not

roles.name: --primary-muted
roles.purpose: a quiet brand tint — a selected row, a panel's header band, and the default badge's fill

roles.name: --radius-pill
roles.purpose: a fully round end: an avatar, a switch, a radio

roles.name: --step-12
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --step-14
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-body
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-strong
roles.purpose: a row title, a field label, a button label, a badge, a dialog title
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-badge
roles.purpose: a compact status or count mark
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-12); font-weight: var(--weight-strong); line-height: var(--line-height-caption)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-button-label
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-14); font-weight: var(--weight-strong); line-height: var(--line-height-body)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-field-label
roles.purpose: the name of a field, above its control; also a fieldset's legend
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-14); font-weight: var(--weight-strong); line-height: var(--line-height-body)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-metadata
roles.purpose: the secondary line beside or under a title — an email, a count, a range
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-12); font-weight: var(--weight-body); line-height: var(--line-height-caption)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.
